notes: gain_parameters contains the effective per-arm initial values and bounds. The inherited top-level bounds entry is unused by run_feedback.fit.
horizon=None means full available customer length; prefix_horizon=1024 describes how existing random draws are preserved before extending, not a training-length truncation.

The actual training optimizer is Powell, xtol=ftol=.001, 191 optimizer evaluations plus explicit initial identity evaluation. All arms use the same maximum budget, not forced identical iteration counts.
New heads share a single optimization-data/noise fit across the two frozen native parents.
No final test events are used. All 32 prospective native generations use the existing development/validation cohort.
